summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA 207078 (LOKELMA). The Summary Review states the application did not raise significant safety or effectiveness issues warranting an AdComm, and the Medical Review (CDTL section) explains the NDA was not presented to the Cardiovascular and Renal Drugs Advisory Committee because efficacy and safety were well characterized, straightforward, and non-controversial. Because no committee was held, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
